import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as robot
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create ground body with contact material and add it to the system
ground_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.5))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# create a long box for rover to cross
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.25, 5, 0.25, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.0))
box.SetFixed(True)
box.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
system.Add(box)
# Create Curiosity rover and add it to the system
rover = robot.Curiosity(system)

# Create driver for rover
driver = robot.CuriosityDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(-5, 0.0, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFramed(init_pos, init_rot))

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Curiosity rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 3, 3), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step

    # ask rover to move forward
    driver.SetSteering(0.0)

    # Update rover dynamics
    rover.Update()

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as robot
from pychrono import irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.sensor as sens  # Added sensor module import

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create ground body with contact material and add it to the system
ground_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(20, 20, 1, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.5))  # Position the ground slightly below the origin
ground.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the ground in place
ground.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"))
system.Add(ground)

# create a long box for rover to cross
box = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(0.25, 5, 0.25, 1000, True, True, ground_mat)
box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.0))
box.SetFixed(True)
box.GetVisualShape(0).SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/blue.png"))
system.Add(box)

# Create Curiosity rover and add it to the system
rover = robot.Curiosity(system)

# Create driver for rover
driver = robot.CuriosityDCMotorControl()
rover.SetDriver(driver)

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(-5, 0.0, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFrameD(init_pos, init_rot))  # Corrected ChFramed to ChFrameD

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Curiosity rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 3, 3), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Create a sensor manager
manager = sens.ChSensorManager(system)  # Added sensor manager creation

# Define lidar parameters
lidar_update_rate = 10.0  # Hz
lidar_horizontal_samples = 360
lidar_vertical_samples = 16
lidar_field_of_view = math.pi  # 180 degrees
lidar_range = 10.0  # meters
lidar_noise = 0.01  # meters

# Create the lidar sensor and attach it to the rover's chassis
lidar_sensor = sens.ChLidarSensor(chrono.ChVector3D(0, 0, 1.5),  # position
                                 chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0),  # orientation
                                 lidar_update_rate,
                                 lidar_horizontal_samples,
                                 lidar_vertical_samples,
                                 lidar_field_of_view,
                                 lidar_range,
                                 lidar_noise)
rover.GetChassisBody().AddChild(lidar_sensor)

# Set up filters for the lidar data
lidar_sensor.SetMinDistance(0.1)  # meters
lidar_sensor.SetMaxDistance(10.0)  # meters

# Add the lidar sensor to the sensor manager
manager.AddSensor(lidar_sensor)

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step

    # ask rover to move forward
    driver.SetSteering(0.0)

    # Update rover dynamics
    rover.Update()

    # Update the sensor manager
    manager.Update()  # Added sensor manager update

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
```

The corrections made to the original script include:

*   Changed `ChFramed` to `ChFrameD` in the `rover.Initialize` method call.
*   Added the sensor module import (`pychrono.sensor`).
*   Created a sensor manager (`sens.ChSensorManager(system)`).
*   Added a lidar sensor to the rover with defined parameters, attached it to the rover's chassis, and set up filters for the lidar data.
*   Added the lidar sensor to the sensor manager.
*   Included updating the sensor manager in the simulation loop (`manager.Update()`).

import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath("path/to/data")

# Create the simulation system
mysystem = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create the ground body
ground = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(mysystem, 10, 2, 10, 1000, True, True)
ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -2, 0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)

# Create the rover
rover = veh.ChWheeledVehicle(mysystem)

# Set up the rover's chassis
chassis = rover.GetChassisBody()
chassis.SetMass(1000)
chassis.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(100, 100, 100))
chassis.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 2, 0))

# Set up the rover's wheels
wheel = veh.ChPartWheeledVehicle()
wheel.SetMass(10)
wheel.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 1))
wheel.SetRadius(0.5)
wheel.SetWidth(0.2)
wheel.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 0, 1))
rover.AddWheel(wheel)

# Set up the rover's suspension
suspension = veh.ChPartSuspension()
suspension.SetMass(5)
suspension.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 1))
suspension.SetLength(0.5)
suspension.SetStiffness(100)
suspension.SetDamping(10)
rover.AddSuspension(suspension)

# Set up the motor control driver
driver = veh.ChMotorDriver()
driver.SetMotorType(veh.ChMotorDriver.MOTOR_TYPE_TORQUE)
driver.SetTorque(100)
rover.AddDriver(driver)

# Set up the collision properties
ground.SetCollide(True)
rover.SetCollide(True)

# Set up the visualization system
viz = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
viz.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
viz.SetWindowTitle("Curiosity Rover Simulation")
viz.SetCameraDistance(10)
viz.SetCameraAzimuth(45)
viz.SetCameraElevation(30)
viz.SetLightDir(chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 1))
viz.SetLightIntensity(1.0)
viz.SetShadows(True)
viz.SetTextures(True)
viz.SetLogo(True)

# Add visual elements to the simulation
viz.AddSkyBox()
viz.AddGrid()
viz.AddLogo()

# Start the simulation
mysystem.SetSolverType(chrono.ChSolver.Type_PSSOR)
mysystem.SetSolverMaxIterations(100)
mysystem.SetSolverTolerance(1e-6)
mysystem.SetTimestep(0.01)
mysystem.SetStepSize(0.01)

while mysystem.GetChTime() < 10:
    mysystem.DoStep()
    viz.BeginScene()
    viz.DrawAll()
    viz.EndScene()

viz.Finalize()
```
